item.title: orders: replace String order status with OrderStatus enum
item.brief:
The `orders` crate stores an order's status as a `String` and compares string literals throughout. Refactor it to a typed enum without changing observable behaviour.

Requirements:
- Add `src/status.rs` with `pub enum OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled }`, deriving at least `Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash`.
- `OrderStatus::as_str(self) -> &'static str` returns "pending", "paid", "shipped", "cancelled". `Display` prints the same strings.
- `impl FromStr for OrderStatus` with `type Err = ParseStatusError`. `ParseStatusError` is a public error type implementing `std::error::Error`, whose message names the rejected input.
- `OrderStatus::can_transition_to(self, next: OrderStatus) -> bool` encodes exactly: pending -> paid, pending -> cancelled, paid -> shipped, paid -> cancelled. Nothing else.
- `Order::status` becomes `OrderStatus`. Re-export `OrderStatus` and `ParseStatusError` from the crate root.
- Use the enum everywhere; status string literals appear only in `src/status.rs`.
- Observable behaviour (errors, report output and ordering, parsing) must stay exactly the same as before. Characterize current behaviour first where it is not already covered by tests.
- `cargo test` must pass.
- Commit nothing with any git identity override; commit as the repository's configured user, with no AI attribution lines.

Acceptance: all of the above, and the change is committed on the local branch.

stages.summary: Replaced the String order status in the `orders` crate with `OrderStatus` (Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled), with observable behaviour unchanged. Two commits on archon/zkpr7gpx-orders-replace-string-order-status-with: 5d7f0a0 pins current behaviour in tests/characterization.rs before the change; b0ed248 adds src/status.rs (as_str, Display, FromStr with ParseStatusError, can_transition_to encoding the four allowed moves), switches Order::status, billing, shipping and report to the enum, and re-exports OrderStatus and ParseStatusError from the root. status_counts now returns (OrderStatus, usize), still sorted by status name. Checks on head: cargo test 16/16 pass, clippy 0 warnings, fmt clean. Independent review passed with no blocking findings (reviewer agt_01M890ASSK4PDDBX0Z33THW964), and a differential run showed base and head output identical. Risk is high because Order::status and status_counts change type (semver break for callers). Not done: I did not add a semver/changelog note, and ParseStatusError exposes no input accessor (non-blocking). The reviewer's Haiku process (pid 2747352) stops when this agent ends. Nothing else is running.

evidence.none: Pure refactor with no visible or measurable change; equivalence is shown by the characterization tests and the differential run instead.

pr.body: Adds src/status.rs: OrderStatus (Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash), as_str, Display, FromStr with ParseStatusError (Display names the rejected input, implements std::error::Error), and can_transition_to (pending->paid, pending->cancelled, paid->shipped, paid->cancelled). Order::status is OrderStatus. billing::pay, shipping::ship and Order::cancel guard via can_transition_to and keep their error text. report::from_line parses the status in the same order of checks as before. report::status_counts returns (OrderStatus, usize) for occurring statuses, sorted by status name. Re-exports OrderStatus and ParseStatusError from the crate root. Status literals only in src/status.rs. Characterization tests (5d7f0a0) pin error text, from_line errors, trimming and status_counts ordering, and passed on the base before the change. Checks on head: cargo test 16/16 pass (3 orders, 9 characterization, 4 status); cargo clippy --all-targets 0 warnings; cargo fmt --check clean. Semver-breaking for callers of Order::status and report::status_counts. Assumption: tests keep exact message and CSV text expectations on purpose. Non-blocking follow-ups: ParseStatusError has no input accessor; a changelog note for the API break.
pr.summary: Order status is now a typed enum. Before: String status with literal comparisons. Now: OrderStatus with one transition table, same observable behaviour.
